words.defn_en: to communicate or transport something from one place to another:

sentences.en: The letter ______ a sense of urgency and concern.
sentences.zh: 這封信傳達了一種急迫與擔憂的感覺。

sentences.en: Her painting manages to ______ deep sorrow without a single word.
sentences.zh: 她的畫作不用一字一句,就能傳達出深深的哀傷。

words.defn_en: to persuade someone to believe or do something:

sentences.en: It took hours to ______ him to change his plans.
sentences.zh: 花了好幾個小時才說服他改變計畫。

sentences.en: The salesman failed to ______ her of the product's value.
sentences.zh: 這位業務員未能說服她相信這產品的價值。

words.defn_en: sociable, outgoing, especially when pertaining to eating and drinking; fond of good company

sentences.en: The dinner party had a ______ atmosphere filled with laughter.
sentences.zh: 這場晚宴洋溢著充滿歡笑的歡樂氣氛。

sentences.en: He enjoyed the ______ company of old friends over a bottle of wine.
sentences.zh: 他喜歡與老朋友一邊喝酒,一邊享受歡樂的相聚時光。

words.defn_en: a large formal assembly of people:

sentences.en: The university held a ______ to welcome new students.
sentences.zh: 這所大學舉行了一場集會來歡迎新生。

sentences.en: Bishops from around the world attended the ______ .
sentences.zh: 來自世界各地的主教出席了這場大會。

words.defn_en: to call together for a formal meeting:

sentences.en: The president ______ d an emergency session of parliament.
sentences.zh: 總統召集了一場緊急國會會議。

sentences.en: The council was ______ d to discuss the crisis.
sentences.zh: 議會被召集起來討論這場危機。

words.defn_en: extremely complex and difficult to follow:

sentences.en: The ______ explanation left everyone confused.
sentences.zh: 這個錯綜複雜的解釋讓大家都感到困惑。

sentences.en: The novel's plot became so ______ that readers struggled to keep track of the characters.
sentences.zh: 這部小說的情節變得如此錯綜複雜,讀者很難跟上所有角色的發展。

words.defn_en: an intricate coiling or complexity:

sentences.en: The novel's plot had too many ______ s to follow easily.
sentences.zh: 這本小說的情節有太多迂迴之處,難以輕易理解。

sentences.en: Each ______ of the brain increases its surface area.
sentences.zh: 大腦的每一道迴旋都增加了它的表面積。

words.defn_en: to coil or twist together:

sentences.en: The vines began to ______ around the trellis.
sentences.zh: 藤蔓開始纏繞在棚架上。

sentences.en: Engineers ______ the two signals to filter out noise.
sentences.zh: 工程師將這兩個訊號進行卷積以濾除雜訊。

words.defn_en: marked by violent, irregular spasms:

sentences.en: The patient suffered a ______ seizure that lasted a minute.
sentences.zh: 這位病患經歷了一場持續一分鐘的痙攣性發作。

sentences.en: Her laughter turned into ______ sobs.
sentences.zh: 她的笑聲轉變成了劇烈的啜泣。

words.defn_en: to work jointly toward a shared goal:

sentences.en: The two nations agreed to ______ on the research project.
sentences.zh: 這兩個國家同意在這項研究計畫上合作。

sentences.en: Employees who ______ across departments finish tasks faster.
sentences.zh: 跨部門合作的員工能更快完成任務。

words.defn_en: free from error; to make right:
words.root_note: com- (thoroughly) + regere (to guide, rule), from Latin

sentences.en: Only one answer on the quiz was ______ .
sentences.zh: 測驗中只有一個答案是正確的。

sentences.en: The teacher asked him to ______ his spelling mistakes.
sentences.zh: 老師要他糾正自己的拼字錯誤。

words.defn_en: the act of correcting an error:
words.root_note: com- (thoroughly) + regere (to guide, rule), from Latin

sentences.en: The newspaper printed a ______ the next day.
sentences.zh: 這份報紙隔天刊登了一則更正啟事。

sentences.en: Her teacher's ______ s helped her improve quickly.
sentences.zh: 她老師的糾正幫助她迅速進步。

words.defn_en: to show a mutual relationship or connection between two things:

sentences.en: The rise in temperature ______ with the increase in energy consumption.
sentences.zh: 氣溫的上升與能源消耗的增加彼此相關。

sentences.en: Higher education levels often ______ with higher income.
sentences.zh: 較高的教育程度通常與較高的收入有所關聯。

words.defn_en: communication by exchanging letters; agreement between things:

sentences.en: The two scientists kept up a lively ______ for decades.
sentences.zh: 這兩位科學家維持了數十年活絡的通信往來。

sentences.en: There was a close ______ between the two sets of data.
sentences.zh: 這兩組數據之間有著密切的一致性。

words.defn_en: capable of being corrected or set right:

sentences.en: The counselor believed the troubled teen was still ______.
sentences.zh: 這位輔導員相信這名問題青少年仍有可矯正的空間。

sentences.en: Unlike his stubborn brother, he proved to be quite ______.
sentences.zh: 與他固執的哥哥不同,他證明自己相當容易被說服改正。

words.defn_en: to confirm, support:

sentences.en: Two independent witnesses were able to ______ her account of the accident.
sentences.zh: 兩名獨立目擊者能夠證實她對這場意外的描述。

sentences.en: New evidence has emerged to ______ the scientist's original theory.
sentences.zh: 新的證據出現,證實了這位科學家最初的理論。

words.defn_en: gradually destructive or harmful:

sentences.en: The ______ chemical has ruined the paint on my car.
sentences.zh: 這種腐蝕性的化學物質已經毀了我車上的烤漆。

sentences.en: Years of ______ rust had weakened the old bridge's supports.
sentences.zh: 多年的腐蝕性鏽蝕已經削弱了這座舊橋的支撐結構。

words.defn_en: dishonest or fraudulent conduct by those in power:

sentences.en: The investigation exposed widespread ______ in the ministry.
sentences.zh: 這項調查揭露了該部會廣泛的貪污現象。

sentences.en: Voters demanded an end to political ______ .
sentences.zh: 選民要求終結政治腐敗。

words.defn_en: to tolerate, approve:

sentences.en: The principal refused to ______ any form of cheating.
sentences.zh: 校長拒絕容忍任何形式的作弊行為。

sentences.en: Her calm ______ betrayed none of the anxiety she felt inside.
sentences.zh: 她平靜的神情絲毫沒有透露出內心的焦慮。

words.defn_en: to thwart, baffle:

sentences.en: The unexpected question seemed to ______ the usually confident speaker.
sentences.zh: 這個突如其來的問題似乎讓這位平時自信滿滿的講者顯得手足無措。

sentences.en: Her sharp reply managed to ______ even her harshest critics.
sentences.zh: 她犀利的回應成功讓連最嚴厲的批評者都感到挫敗。

words.defn_en: disjointed:

sentences.en: After the accident, the driver seemed dazed and gave an ______ statement to police.
sentences.zh: 意外發生後,駕駛顯得神智不清,向警方做出語無倫次的陳述。

sentences.en: His essay was so ______ that the teacher couldn't follow his argument.
sentences.zh: 他的文章語無倫次,老師完全跟不上他的論點。

words.defn_en: not leading to a clear or definite conclusion; ambiguous:

sentences.en: The results of the experiment were ______, so further testing was needed.
sentences.zh: 這項實驗的結果尚無定論,因此需要進一步的測試。

sentences.en: The investigation remains ______ after months of inquiry.
sentences.zh: 經過數月的調查,這起案件仍然懸而未決。

words.defn_en: irrelevant; of no significance; unimportant

sentences.en: The disagreement over lunch plans seemed ______ compared to the bigger issues.
sentences.zh: 與更重大的議題相比,午餐計畫上的分歧顯得無關緊要。

sentences.en: He dismissed the criticism as ______ and moved on with his plan.
sentences.zh: 他把這項批評視為無關緊要,繼續執行自己的計畫。

words.defn_en: hardly noticeable

sentences.en: He tried to remain ______ while sneaking into the meeting late.
sentences.zh: 他試圖悄悄地不引人注意地溜進遲到的會議。

sentences.en: The safe was hidden behind an ______ bookshelf.
sentences.zh: 這個保險箱被藏在一個不起眼的書架後面。

words.defn_en: unreasonable, unjust:

sentences.en: Charging that much for a bottle of water is simply ______.
sentences.zh: 為一瓶水收取那麼高的費用實在毫無道理。

sentences.en: It would be ______ to fire her without any warning.
sentences.zh: 毫無預警就解僱她,實在是說不過去。
